sampleDataset.description: Small campaign table (channels, rates, revenue). Upload this in “Upload data”, then choose a preset below and run the evidence workflow.

presets.label: Next campaign — ₹50k
presets.query: Using budget, channel, audience, click_rate, conversion_rate, and revenue, recommend the next campaign to run with a ₹50,000 budget. Name the closest winning pattern in this dataset and explain why.

presets.label: ROI — best channel
presets.query: Rank the campaigns by revenue per dollar of budget, then compare LinkedIn, Email, and Meta to identify which channel looks strongest in this dataset.
presets.note: Matches the sample CSV columns exactly.

presets.label: Audience + offer
presets.query: Which audience and offer_type combination appears strongest based on conversion_rate and revenue? Summarize the evidence from the uploaded dataset.
presets.note: Good fit for the sample campaign table.

presets.label: B2B SaaS recommendation
presets.query: Focus on rows where audience is B2B SaaS. Based on budget, click_rate, conversion_rate, and revenue, what messaging and offer_type should I repeat next?
presets.note: Targeted prompt aligned to actual sample rows.
